verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents item merging to combine multiple items into one group, which covers merging issues that are the same bug. Its Custom Fingerprinting Rules address cases where default grouping separates occurrences you want combined, or combines ones you want separated, which covers splitting wrongly collapsed issues. Missing for 10: evidence of splitting an existing merged or collapsed item directly in the UI (fingerprint rules appear to be configuration that shapes grouping rather than an on-item split action), detail on whether rules apply retroactively, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
